title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. translated_title: RSI-Anything：利用世界模型解锁递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）旨在将交互经验转化为持续的改进，然而外部反馈代价高昂，且随着策略的演化，世界模型的预测可能变得不可靠。我们提出了 RSI-Anything，一个构建在 JEPA-Anything 之上的通用领域框架，它利用预测性世界模型来指导行动和学习数据的选择。观测到的反馈驱动策略或工作流的改进以及条件性的世界模型适配，同时组件与兼容性检查决定更新后的策略-模型对是否被保留。在多种计算与科学领域中，RSI-Anything 展现了显著的提升。在代码修复任务中，在固定编码器的情况下，成功率从使用静态验证器的 26.3% 通过预测性选择提升至 29.2%，经世界模型适配后进一步提升至 31.2%，且测试用量相当。图形用户界面（GUI）评估显示任务完成率更高，同时平均操作次数下降（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了基于预测性世界模型的通用递归自我改进框架 RSI-Anything，通过世界模型指导行动与学习数据选择，并借助兼容性检查决定更新保留，在代码修复和GUI任务中实现了显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: RSI-Anything is a domain-general recursive self-improvement framework that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection, achieving substantial gains in code repair and GUI tasks.
